the probability that an alliance member will contribute troops to a NATO operation increases as the alliance member’s perception of threat from the target state increases, as the alliance member believes that the operation is likely to be successful, as the alliance members’ belief that the target state poses a threat to other alliance members increases, and as the alliance members believe the operation is consistent with the alliance’s core values and interests.
